record.issue_text: [BUG] When PostCreator#create returns nil inside the transaction, the code silently continues (embed never created, post stays nil) and import returns nil with no log or error result PollFeed treats the item as processed and moves on; the embed page keeps serving the loading loop with no record that topic creation failed

adjudication.rationale: In `TopicEmbed.import`, the creation path wraps `PostCreator.new(...).create` in a transaction and only creates the `TopicEmbed` row if `post.present?` (app/models/topic_embed.rb). If `create` returns `nil`/blank, the method returns `nil` with no logging or error propagation. Callers like `Jobs::PollFeed#poll_feed` ignore the return value and continue iterating (app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb), so failures are silent and the embed UI can stay in the "loading" state if no `TopicEmbed` is ever created (app/controllers/embed_controller.rb + loading.html.erb). However, the finding’s claim that PollFeed “treats the item as processed” is overstated—there’s no persisted per-item processed state in the diff, so it would simply try again on the next run/request. The real issue is missing failure reporting/handling for post creation failures, not a provable one-time loss of processing.
